name: safe-trade-rule-builder
description: Safe-trading plugin for KakaoPay Securities with two audiences. For in-house developers and QA (market-hours-guard): check that trading-hours changes (KRX after-market/pre-market, NXT sessions, SOR window, US DST) are applied consistently across code and config, and generate boundary-time tests. For investors (safe-trade-rule-builder): compute forced-liquidation (반대매매) deadlines and required deposits for credit trading, and turn natural-language trade requests into safe, manually confirmed rule drafts.

interface.shortDescription: 개발자에게는 거래시간 변경 점검, 투자자에게는 반대매매·안전 매매 점검.
interface.longDescription: Two skills in one plugin. market-hours-guard (in-house developers and QA): compares time values scattered across brokerage code and config with an approved session calendar, flags stale, DST-unsafe, or ambiguous values, lets Codex fix them with traceable annotations, and generates boundary-time tests. safe-trade-rule-builder (investors): checks credit-trading collateral ratios against KakaoPay Securities' published rules (140% maintenance, 120% emergency, D+1/D+2, temporary grace) with sources, and converts natural-language buy or sell requests into explainable rule drafts with time-window checks, policy guardrails, and manual confirmation. No live orders.
defaultPrompt: SOR 적용 시간이 20:00까지 늘어난 변경이 이 저장소에 빠짐없이 반영됐는지 점검하고 경계 테스트까지 만들어줘.
미국 서머타임 해제 후 한국시간 고정값이 남아 있는지 찾아서 고쳐줘.
삼성전자가 3% 떨어지면 신용으로 100만원어치 매수 후보로 알려줘.
